# Brand assets: logo and Torq

> **Status: drafts.** The skull is a vector redraw of the owner's concept art (faceted gray T-Rex skull,
> open jaw, lime/red facets, tachometer eye with a red needle). The concept's "DYNO" wordmark is legacy:
> the name is **DYNOREX**. The original concept image is not in the repo yet; save it as
> `assets/brand/source/concept-dyno-legacy.png` for reference. Torq is still an engineering draft.
> A designer should refine `src/components/mascot/art.ts` (the single source), then run `npm run brand:export`.

## Rules

- Clear space: at least the eye-socket diameter on every side of the mark.
- Minimum size: mark 24 px tall; lockup 120 px wide (wordmark legibility).
- Approved backgrounds: Asphalt Black (full colour); Card surface; any dark photo only with the mono-light variant.
- Never crop the skull, teeth, eye or tachometer needle; never recolour outside the palette; never stretch,
  outline, add glow, or place the full-colour mark on light backgrounds.
- The app icon has no wordmark (illegible at small size).
- Torq: always outlined in #AAAAAA so he stays visible on Asphalt. Never covers controls or text,
  never stands in for a user's real vehicle, never celebrates something that hasn't actually succeeded.

## Acceptance checks for final art (designer)

1. Tachometer needle readable in `app-icon-60.png` and `app-icon-40.png`.
2. Torq silhouette recognisable at 48 px; each pose distinct at 90 px.
3. All Torq PNGs have transparent backgrounds and no edge halos on #111315.
4. Mono and one-colour variants keep teeth, eye and needle distinct.
5. Re-run `npm run brand:export`; app builds pick up the new icon and splash.
